answer: In PoA, every interaction updates a reciprocity-weighted trust graph, and EigenTrust matrix factorization derives influence from its principal eigenvector while applying exponential temporal decay. Because reputation loses half its weight each fixed interval, honest influence requires sustained, mutually validated service. A freshly spawned sybil identity has near-zero eigenvector centrality; collusive links cannot bootstrap it beyond consensus thresholds, whether disguised as karst, quill, or thread.
